$comment: One entry per skill catalog. scripts/gen-skills-catalog.mjs (frontmatter, packaging) and scripts/check-skill-contracts.mjs (verbs, cross-catalog names, protocol copies) iterate every entry, each with its own prefix and verb regex.

outputs names the build outputs a catalog feeds. null means the catalog is kept out of that output on purpose. Since REL-01 the ow- catalog feeds its own zips (public/opchain-work-skills.zip and public/work/<id>.zip, scripts/make-work-skills-zip.sh), its own docs tree (public/docs/work, scripts/sync-work-docs.sh), the public mirror (skills-work/ in mirror-public.yml) and its own site section (`site`: /work, site/src/pages/work, read through the `work` content collection in site/src/content.config.ts, which never sums ow- counts with the oc- catalog's); it stays out of the dev plugin, the flag registry and the hosted MCP catalog (null).

The scripts that write the oc- outputs (sync-plugin-skills, sync-skill-bundles, make-skills-zip, sync-docs, gen-mcp-catalog) refuse a source tree holding any skill outside the oc- prefix, so pointing OPCHAIN_SKILLS_DIR at skills-work/ fails before anything is deleted or written. The ow- scripts (make-work-skills-zip, sync-work-docs) refuse any non-ow- tree the same way, and refuse to write until gen-skills-catalog and check-skill-contracts pass for the exact tree (OPCHAIN_WORK_SKILLS_DIR); scripts/check-work-install.mjs then installs the built zips into an empty folder and compares every file with skills-work/.

edges names the per-skill edges file (ow- contract R15). planned lists family skills not built yet; plannedVerbs declares the verbs a NEXT block may already name for one of them (ow-documentation's NEXT names /ow-care-request after the rollout closes, OW-05; ow-handoff's close NEXT names /ow-care-start for care-start.md and its after-close NEXT /ow-care-request, OW-06). ow-handoff left planned in OW-06 (1.0.0) and ow-care in OW-07 (1.0.0, salvaged from the Codex draft PR 652 on 2026-10-29): each one's edges file now holds every sibling's reads of it to reciprocity, ow-start's index rows for ow-care's files included. bodyTokenBudgets caps one skill's body below the catalog's bodyTokenBudget. statusNames names what a verb's STATUS lines must carry (every `next: … | awaiting: …` template in its phase file). Both resolve names only: reciprocity is checked once the planned skill has its own edges file.

ow-research (OW-09, owner decision O9): ow-vendor-eval, ow-currency and ow-controls are planned. ow-draft was planned on the same terms and is built (OW-10): its /ow-draft-evidence is a declared verb now, and the ow-research to ow-draft edge is reciprocal. ow-currency and ow-controls moved to v2.2 (owner decision 2026-10-19) and ow-vendor-eval (OW-11) followed on 2026-10-22: /ow-currency-watch stays declared for the hand-off that returns with ow-currency, though no ow-research screen names it in 2.1; /ow-vendor-eval-evidence is not declared, because no 2.1 text names it and it returns with ow-vendor-eval in v2.2; ow-controls is named by ow-research's licensed-text refusal as not in this release.
